tickets.title: Build reviewed versioned projection contracts and executable negative cases
gate_cmd:
import json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('SYSTEMS/proposals/headless-v2')
s=json.loads((p/'projection-v2.schema.json').read_text())
assert s['$schema']=='https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema'
assert s['$id']=='https://argo.local/schemas/projection-v2.json'
for name in ('Prefix','PlaneCursor','CommonCheckpoint','CanonicalRelationVersion','EpistemicClaim','Acquisition','ActorKnowledgeQuery','CanonicalHistoryQuery','ActorKnowledgeView','IdEntries'):
 assert name in s['$defs'],name
m=json.loads(Path('docs/projection-contracts/profile.json').read_text())
assert m['schema_version']==1 and m['profile']=='projection/2.0.0'
assert m['paid_runs'] is False and m['persistent_graph_implemented'] is False
assert m['status'] in ('reviewed_candidate','frozen_local_contract')
for f in m['artifacts']:assert Path(f).is_file(),f
v1=json.loads(Path('SYSTEMS/CONTRACT_FREEZE.json').read_text())
for f,h in v1['files'].items():assert hashlib.sha256(Path(f).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h,f
assert Path('TESTS/projection-contracts.test.ts').is_file()
assert Path('packages/contracts/src/projection-v2.ts').is_file()
print('PASS projection packet structure and unchanged v1 freeze; application acceptance is external')
